name: dubi-mobile-shell
description: DUBI static frontend packaged as a native mobile app with Capacitor.

scripts.cap:open:android: node scripts/prepare-mobile-web.js && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.cap:open:ios: node scripts/prepare-mobile-web.js && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: node scripts/prepare-mobile-web.js && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: node scripts/prepare-mobile-web.js && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
